summary: AI productivity and workspace tools have reached mainstream enterprise adoption in 2026, with generative AI now embedded directly into the platforms where knowledge workers spend most of their time — email, documents, meetings, and search. The market is led by tools integrated into existing ecosystems like Microsoft Copilot for M365 and Google Workspace Gemini, while standalone tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Notion AI command massive user bases through accessibility and versatility. Meeting intelligence, AI writing assistance, and knowledge management represent the fastest-growing segments, with enterprise deployments accelerating across all sectors.
